acceptance.acceptance: Every supported assurance-by-diagnostics composition and local upgrade/downgrade path has an explicit acceptance arm. Missing typed prerequisites fail at compile time where possible; graph, contract, domain or capability incompatibility fails synchronously and failure-atomically before partial topology remains; missing runtime facts remain quiet or bounded DataIssue/coverage DATA rather than protocol ERROR or lifecycle repair. Mutation tests fail when a required prerequisite, occurrence, join, conservation, result or coverage edge is removed.
